pages.title: Illusion Bow
pages.text:
RuneRegister (RuneRegister) -> Illusion Bow ->
Pops the RuneRegister, creates an illusion bow

Mana cost 25 on summon, requires 1 mana per second to maintain form.
Disappears immediately when thrown from inventory.

On arrow hit, executes the rune fragments in the register as a new spell, pushing the hit entity onto the new spell stack before execution
